title: Spectral bounds and their limits in Pauli contextuality: exact configurations and a proof of Jonah's Conjecture E
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; listed on ORCID)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
core_result: Unified study with complete Lean 4.35.0 formalizations of the spectral floor, Theorem 2 (Kramers / quaternionic floor and elliptic quadrics Q-(2N-1,2)), Theorems 3-4 (5-way saturation equivalences and (2^N-1)|S| = square), exact contextuality degrees (75, 480, 729344) for 4-, 5-, and 7-qubit configurations, a four-qubit cospectral C3 pair with distinct completion spectra, Lemmas 20-21 (Jordan restriction and universal cubic-trace identity), and Theorem 19: a full machine-checked Lean 4 proof of Jonah's Conjecture E across all nine vertex cases (C1, C3, C5, C6, C8, C11, C12, C14, C15) for every N >= 4.
verification_boundary: As of v1.5.0, the spectral floor, Kramers quaternionic floor, 5-way saturation equivalences, saturated configurations, four-qubit C3 certificate, all-qubit C3 family, Lemmas 20-21, and Theorem 19 (Jonah's Conjecture E in all 9 vertex cases for every N >= 4) are all kernel-checked in Lean 4.35.0 with zero sorry, zero native_decide, and strictly standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Historical source manuscripts remain preserved inside the repository as component records of this single combined study (see publication/PAPER-MAP.md).
